about: The fixed case set of lib/question-reuse.js INSTRUCTIONS (tools/prompt-cases.json set question-reuse): each form label and the verdict it must get. A question about this one employer is one job's even when it does not name it (owner, 28 Oct 2026: the 21-item queue held How did you hear and Previously worked here); a stance or fact the applicant gives every employer stays reusable. Fictional employers. sensitive (PR D1a, owner 28 Oct 2026): EEO, disability, criminal record are true and reach no AI reader (lib/about-you.js); a background-check consent or a driving licence is false; Pronouns is not scored.
